name: Quinoa Power Bowl
description: Nutrient-dense quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables and chickpeas
instructions: Prepare 1 cup quinoa, 1 cup chickpeas, 2 cups roasted vegetables as directed in the ingredient list. Combine in a serving dish. For optimal flavor and texture, allow to sit for a few minutes before enjoying. This lunch provides balanced nutrition to power you through the afternoon.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: Lean grilled chicken over mixed greens with high-fiber vegetables
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and a little olive oil. Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) and chicken has nice grill marks. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice into strips. Meanwhile, toss mixed greens with halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and pumpkin seeds. Arrange greens on plates, top with sliced chicken, and drizzle with your favorite olive oil vinaigrette. Serve immediately.

name: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
description: Hearty lentil soup packed with fiber and plant-based protein
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion, carrot, and celery, cooking for 5-6 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add rinsed red lentils, vegetable broth, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender. Add chopped spinach and stir until wilted (about 2 minutes). Season with salt, pepper, and dried thyme. Serve hot, optionally with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Turkey and Avocado Wrap
description: Lean turkey with avocado and vegetables in a high-fiber wrap
instructions: Prepare 6 oz turkey breast, whole grain wrap, 1/2 avocado as directed in the ingredient list. Combine in a serving dish. For optimal flavor and texture, allow to sit for a few minutes before enjoying. This lunch provides balanced nutrition to power you through the afternoon.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic pasta with rich meat sauce and parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water according to package directions until al dente (usually 8-10 minutes), then drain well. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until translucent. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned (5-7 minutes). Pour in tomato sauce and add dried basil and oregano. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes to develop flavors. Season with salt and pepper. Serve sauce over spaghetti with parmesan cheese sprinkled on top.

name: Pasta Carbonara
description: Creamy pasta with bacon, eggs, and parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook fettuccine or spaghetti in salted water according to package directions until al dente, then drain well, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water. While pasta cooks, fry bacon in a large pan over medium heat until crispy (4-5 minutes), then remove and set aside on paper towels. In a bowl, whisk eggs with grated parmesan and plenty of black pepper. Remove pan from heat and add a splash of olive oil. Immediately pour in drained pasta (not the reserved water yet), tossing to coat slightly. Add bacon and egg-cheese mixture to the pasta, tossing vigorously off heat to create a creamy sauce using the hot pasta. If too thick, add reserved pasta water 1 tablespoon at a time until smooth. Serve immediately with extra parmesan and black pepper.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, romaine, and caesar dressing in a whole wheat wrap
instructions: Prepare 4 oz grilled chicken, whole wheat tortilla, 2 cups romaine as directed in the ingredient list. Combine in a serving dish. For optimal flavor and texture, allow to sit for a few minutes before enjoying. This lunch provides balanced nutrition to power you through the afternoon.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
description: Classic tuna salad with celery and onion on whole grain bread
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients using a gentle folding motion to maintain texture. Mix until just combined - avoid overmixing which can make the dish tough or watery. Let rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Creamy egg salad with herbs on whole grain bread
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients using a gentle folding motion to maintain texture. Mix until just combined - avoid overmixing which can make the dish tough or watery. Let rest for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with ground turkey, rice, and tomatoes
instructions: Prepare 2 bell peppers, 4 oz ground turkey, 1/2 cup cooked rice as directed in the ingredient list. Combine in a serving dish. For optimal flavor and texture, allow to sit for a few minutes before enjoying. This lunch provides balanced nutrition to power you through the afternoon.

name: Shrimp Scampi Pasta
description: Garlic shrimp with pasta in white wine and butter sauce
instructions: Heat a large skillet or pan over medium-high heat. Add oil and allow it to get hot. Cook the protein according to recipe instructions until browned and cooked through. Add vegetables and cook until tender-crisp. Combine with sauce and serve immediately.

name: Falafel Wrap
description: Crispy falafel with tahini sauce and vegetables in whole wheat wrap
instructions: Prepare 4 falafel balls, whole wheat wrap, 2 tbsp tahini as directed in the ingredient list. Combine in a serving dish. For optimal flavor and texture, allow to sit for a few minutes before enjoying. This lunch provides balanced nutrition to power you through the afternoon.

name: Greek Chicken Gyro
description: Seasoned chicken with tzatziki sauce in pita bread
instructions: Heat a large skillet or pan over medium-high heat. Add oil and allow it to get hot. Cook the protein according to recipe instructions until browned and cooked through. Add vegetables and cook until tender-crisp. Combine with sauce and serve immediately.

name: Sushi Bowl
description: Deconstructed sushi with salmon, avocado, and vegetables over rice
instructions: Prepare 1 cup sushi rice, 4 oz salmon, 1/2 avocado as directed in the ingredient list. Combine in a serving dish. For optimal flavor and texture, allow to sit for a few minutes before enjoying. This lunch provides balanced nutrition to power you through the afternoon.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting soup with chicken, vegetables, and egg noodles
instructions: Heat a large skillet or pan over medium-high heat. Add oil and allow it to get hot. Cook the protein according to recipe instructions until browned and cooked through. Add vegetables and cook until tender-crisp. Combine with sauce and serve immediately.

name: Korean Beef Bowl with Fermented Vegetables
description: Quick ground beef bowl with kimchi, pickled vegetables, and sesame
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with sesame oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (6-8 minutes). Add minced garlic, ginger, and soy sauce, stirring for 1 minute. Add gochujang and mix well. Remove from heat. In a bowl, layer steamed rice, beef mixture, kimchi, and quick-pickled cucumber and radish. Top with a fried egg and sprinkle sesame seeds. Drizzle with extra gochujang if desired. Mix thoroughly before eating.

name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwich
description: Tender BBQ chicken on a brioche bun with coleslaw
instructions: Slow cook chicken in BBQ sauce until tender. Toast brioche buns. Assemble sandwiches with pulled chicken, coleslaw, and pickles.

name: Salmon Niçoise Salad
description: Classic French salad with grilled salmon and boiled eggs
instructions: Grill salmon and flake. Boil eggs and potatoes. Arrange greens, green beans, olives, tomatoes, and hard-boiled eggs. Top with salmon and vinaigrette.

name: Thai Peanut Noodle Bowl
description: Rice noodles with peanut sauce and grilled chicken
instructions: Cook rice noodles. Grill chicken and slice. Whisk peanut sauce. Combine noodles, chicken, vegetables, and peanut sauce. Top with peanuts and cilantro.

name: Curried Chickpea Bowl
description: Aromatic curried chickpeas over basmati rice
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic. Add spices and chickpeas. Simmer until flavorful. Serve over basmati rice with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowl
description: Spiced chicken shawarma over rice with garlic sauce
instructions: Season chicken with shawarma spices and grill until cooked. Slice chicken. Serve over rice with garlic sauce, pickles, tomatoes, and parsley.

name: Mexican Chipotle Chicken Bowl
description: Spiced chicken in chipotle sauce over rice
instructions: Season chicken with chipotle and grill until cooked. Slice and mix with chipotle sauce. Serve over rice with black beans and corn.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: Fresh quinoa salad with Mediterranean vegetables and feta cheese
instructions: Cook 1 cup quinoa according to package directions and let cool completely. In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa, 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 1/2 cucumber (diced), 1/4 cup red onion (thinly sliced), 1/2 cup Kalamata olives, and 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese. In a small bowl, whisk together 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine. Let salad marinate for 15 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Crispy lettuce cups filled with seasoned chicken and vegetables
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 6 oz ground chicken and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned (5-6 minutes). Add 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger, and 1/4 cup diced water chestnuts. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tsp honey. Add sauce to chicken and stir until coated. Remove from heat and stir in 2 sliced green onions and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro. Spoon mixture into butter lettuce cups and serve immediately.

name: Vietnamese Pho with Beef
description: Traditional Vietnamese noodle soup with beef and herbs
instructions: In a large pot, bring 6 cups beef broth to a simmer. Add 1 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 cloves, and 1 slice ginger. Simmer for 15 minutes. Cook 6 oz rice noodles according to package directions. In bowls, arrange 4 oz thinly sliced beef, cooked noodles, bean sprouts, and basil. Pour hot broth over beef (it will cook from the heat). Top with sliced green onions, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime. Serve with hoisin sauce and sriracha.
